title: Greatest Love of All
lyrics:
[00:00.000] 作词 : Creed, Masser
[00:01.000] 作曲 : Linda Creed/Michael Masser
[00:25.297]I believe the children are our future
[00:29.000]Teach them well and let them lead the way
[00:32.584]Show them all the beauty they possess inside
[00:38.551]Give them a sense of pride to make it easier
[00:45.514]Let the children's laughter remind us how we used to be
[00:54.875]Everybody's searching for a hero
[00:58.575]People need someone to look up to
[01:02.039]I never found anyone who fulfilled my needs
[01:07.995]A lonely place to be
[01:12.124]And so I learned to depend on me
[01:17.012]I decided long ago
[01:20.197]Never to walk in anyone's shadows
[01:24.210]If I fail, if I succeed
[01:27.387]At least I'll live as I believe
[01:30.986]No matter what they take from me
[01:34.748]They can't take away my dignity
[01:39.237]Because the greatest love of all
[01:46.129]Is happening to me
[01:53.463]I found the greatest love of all
[02:00.822]Inside of me
[02:04.514]The greatest love of all
[02:12.087]Is easy to achieve
[02:19.750]Learning to love yourself
[02:24.653]It is the greatest love of all
[02:33.001]I believe the children are our future
[02:36.674]Teach them well and let them lead the way
[02:40.219]Show them all the beauty they possess inside
[02:46.194]Give them a sense of pride to make it easier
[02:53.059]Let the children's laughter remind us how we used to be
[03:02.496]I decided long ago
[03:05.638]Never to walk in anyone's shadows
[03:09.632]If I fail, if I succeed
[03:12.770]At least I'll live as I believe
[03:16.243]No matter what they take from me
[03:20.052]They can't take away my dignity
[03:24.723]Because the greatest love of all
[03:31.616]Is happening to me
[03:38.732]I found the greatest love of all
[03:46.166]Inside of me
[03:49.871]The greatest love of all
[03:57.197]Is easy to achieve
[04:04.620]Learning to love yourself
[04:09.983]It is the greatest love of all
[04:15.951]And if, by chance, that special place
[04:23.523]That you've been dreaming of
[04:31.141]Leads you to a lonely place
[04:36.732]Find your strength in love
